svg.title: Known-best packing of 211 unit squares
svg.desc: The retained known-best n=211 construction, normalized to Witness/v2 and rendered with the repository's deterministic house renderer.

sqpack:profile.sqpack:value: Complete c3d17ab rational centre/half-angle certificate in the source's sqcert format, centres in [0, S]^2, read from the retained file at the pin. Finite construction feasibility only; no local minimum, KKT, rigidity, novelty, priority or global optimality claim.
